self.title: What If Our Starting Assumptions Are Wrong?

detail.title: Assessing Epistemic Self-Correction Limits
detail.question: Can automated systems reliably identify and correct foundational methodological assumptions without external intervention?
detail.reason: Maintaining ongoing investigation into automated epistemic self-correction limits.

detail.title: Limitations of Automated Epistemic Self-Correction
detail.summary: Analysis of automated decision-making and cognitive systems indicates that while algorithmic frameworks can process complex tasks, identifying and revising foundational methodological assumptions typically requires external oversight and normative evaluation.
detail.reason: Synthesizing available source material on automated decision-making and cognitive extension to address the project question.
